items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public data display, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and security-sensitive release. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked/private. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries are preserved. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution or commercial-use rights; public terms restrict listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Compliance is technical-only at 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner/consent, privacy, and terms findings. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Analytics quality is yellow, and Amazon's $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 is aggregate and unattributed. Human counsel is required before any Woot permission request or rights-dependent launch decision. No go-live decision is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Exact next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and make no launch-state, production, tracking, credential, configuration, alert-scope, or monetization change.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rules; trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising permissions. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory. No data-use item is clear or conditional for public beta yet.

Compliance and launch decision: do not dispatch or requeue new work this cycle. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, ownership, legal/security evidence, parked-site verification, and attribution reconciliation. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but preserve consent gating, affiliate disclosures, destination integrity, registered tracking IDs, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Recheck only after dated ownership, validation, rollback, security, attribution, deduplication, and measurement evidence is attached.
